title: v3.1.5: Folders Se Breakup, App Deck Se Shaadi
summary: Aaj humne folders ko unki asli jagah dikhayi (Rename/Delete) aur App Deck ko itna haseen banaya ki Shark Tank wale bhi ro den.
body:
📂 Custom Folder ka Swayamvar

Pehle sirf 'T1, T2' bolke kaam chalana padta tha, ab user bola — 'Mujhe Charts ke liye alag kamra chahiye!'. Toh humne de diya Custom Folders.
Lekin twist? Agar folder delete kiya toh images gayab nahi hoti, wo wapas 'OPEN' section me aa jati hain (Ghar wapsi style). Ab rename karo ya delete, kalesh khatam.

📉 App Deck: 4-3-4-3 Ka Magic

App Deck ko generic se 'Jordaar' mode me shift kiya. 4-3-4-3 ka layout banaya taaki aakhon ko sukoon mile. Humne bataya ki hamara app 'Zero Manual Entry' wala hai — kyunki hum traders hain, data entry operators nahi! Pattern recognize karo, TYPING nahi.

title: v3.1.4: TRULY Full Backup — Kyunki Pata Nahi Agla Din Hoga Ya Nahi
summary: Full project ka insurance kar liya. Saara media aur trades ab ek ZIP me band hain. Plus, Shortcuts ka kalesh fix kiya.
body:
💾 Backup: Life Insurance for Trades

Bina backup ke trading journal chalana matlab bina helmet ke bike chalana. Aaj humne 'TRULY Full Backup' launch kiya. JSON ke saath saath saari images, audio, video — sab lapet liya ek ZIP me. Ab laptop blast bhi ho jaye, data amar rahega!

⌨️ 'F' for Respect (and Filter)

Gallery me 'F' dabate hi filter khulna tha, lekin jab search baar me 'FOMO' likho toh gallery jump karne lagti thi. Bechari confusion me thi! Aaj keyboard shortcuts ko hidayat di gayi — 'Jab search box me ho, toh chup raho!'. Ab search aur shortcuts ke beech dosti ho gayi hai.

title: v3.1.3: Zero-Click Sync — Ab API Karegi Majdoori
summary: Manual sync button dabate dabate ungli thak gayi thi, toh humne robot laga diya. Plus, Tag Pins me ab aap prem patra likh sakte hain (Notes feature).
body:
🐢 Alvida Manual Sync

Pehle data lane ke liye button dabao, wait karo, phir pray karo. Ab system khud check karta hai — 'Bhai ka data missing hai? Main lata hoon!'. Background worker chupke se data fetch karta hai aur progress bar dikhata hai. Zero manual intervention, 100% Shanti.

📝 Tag Pin Prem Patra

Tags sirf naam ke nahi rahe. Ab har tag pe click karo aur side drawer me poori kahani likho. 'Ye Setup kyun fail hua?' — ab user yahan apna dard likh sakta hai. Rich text editor hai, toh bold/italic me apne dukh ko highlight karo!

title: v3.1.2: Manual Pivot Editor — Chart Pe Drawing Ka Shauk
summary: Dhan API kabhi kabhi dandi marti thi, toh humne Pivot Editor bana diya. Excel se level lao aur chart pe chipkao. Ledger ab itna haseen hai ki CA bhi impress ho jaye.
body:
Levels agar sahi na hon toh trade 'Intuition' ban jati hai (aur humein pata hai uska anjaam). Aaj 'Pivot Editor' aaya — Excel se bulk paste support ke saath. Levels galat? Toh override maar do!

📊 Ledger Ka Transformation

Purana history modal thoda gareeb lag raha tha. Aaj usko 'Corporate' look diya. Per-instrument P/L breakdown ke saath nested rows. Ab aap dekh sakte ho ki Nifty ne profit diya par Option ne brokerage me lut liya.

title: v3.1.0: Strategy Lab — Ab Do Ankhen Kam Padengi
summary: The Cockpit is here! Left me Index, Right me Option. Sync zoom itna smooth hai ki makkhan bhi sharman jaye.
body:
🔭 Eagle Eye Mode

Sirf option chart dekhna matlab andhere me teer chalana. Humne Split View banaya. Index aur Option saath-saath. Zoom ek me karo, dusra apne aap follow karega (jaise pati-patni).
Arsalan Reversal (AR) logic ko charts pe auto-markings di gayi. Ab chart bolta hai — 'Buy Here, Sell There!'.

title: v3.0.5: JS Bundling — Phir Se 18 Saal Ka Josh
summary: App itna slow tha ki chai thandi ho jati thi. Aaj bundling ki aur ab loading speed dekh kar browser ko bhi chakkar aa rahe hain.
body:
🏎️ Need for Speed

40+ files load karna matlab mela ghoomne jaisa tha. Aaj sabko ek 'Bundle' me bandh diya. Application ab rocket ki tarah load hoti hai (0.8s!). CDN dependencies ko bhi ghar bula liya (Local sync) taaki internet nakhre na dikhaye.

title: v3.0.4: Tag Templates — 'Copy-Paste' Ka Professional Version
summary: Har image pe wahi tags lagana boring tha, toh templates bana diye. iPad walo ke liye tray ko thodi 'Tameez' sikhayi.
body:
📋 Tag Templates: Alsi Logo Ke Liye Vardaan

Agar aapko har trade me 'FOMO, Overtrade, Revenge' likhna padta hai, toh ab sirf ek template banao aur 1-click me saare gunah kabool karo.
iPad me tray kabhi upar kabhi niche bhag rahi thi — usko fix kiya aur 5-column grid ribbon diya. Ab iPad pe journal karna iPad kridne jitna hi cool hai.

title: v3.0.3: PDF Export — Ab Print Karwa Lo Apna Dard
summary: Gallery selection ko 'Orange Highlight' ka tadka diya aur PDF engine ko itna power diya ki print-out nikalte hi chart asli lagne lage.
body:
📄 PDF Export: Pro Mode

Ab poori trade history ko PDF me export karo. Charts, tags, notes sab ek jagah.
Thumbnail panel me 'Orange Highlights' wapas laye — kyunki jab tak selected image chamke nahi, maza nahi aata. Shift-click selection bhi restore hui, ab bulk tagging thoda kam thakau hai!

title: v3.0.2: Gallery Tray iPad Polish — Tray Wahin Rukegi Jahan Chhoda
summary: Tray kabhi yahan kabhi wahan bhag rahi thi, aaj usko fixed positions sikhayi. iPad touch drag ab makkhan jaisa smooth hai.
body:
🐕 Wafadar Tray

Pehle gallery swipe karo toh tray wapas reset ho jati thi. Aaj use 'Persistence' ka paath padhaya. Jahan chhoda hai, wahin milegi.
SNAP threshold ko humne 120px kiya taaki touch-drag me dhappa na ho jaye. PWA meta tags bhi add kar diye, ab iPad pe bina browser-chrome ke 'Asli App' jaisa feel aayega.

title: v3.0.1: Interactive Tabs — Sab Kuch Ek Hi Chhat Ke Neeche
summary: Monthly Summary aur Quick Stats ke beech jo doori thi, wo aaj khatam hui. Sabko ek hi unified tab control me merge kar diya.
body:
Stats dekhne ke liye yahan-wahan bhatakna band. Aaj unified 'Interactive Tabs' launch kiye.
Dashboard ab clutter-free hai, aur har click pe analytics instantly switch hoti hai. 'Pro Trader' vibes intensify!

title: v3.0.0: iPad Gesture Overhaul — Pinch & Pan Like a Pro
summary: iPad pe charts zoom karna pehle thoda ajeeb tha. Aaj Pinch-Zoom aur Momentum Scroll add kiya, ab chart pe 'Spider-Man' bano.
body:
🤏 Pinch to Zoom: Finally!

Charts ko zoom karne ke liye ab pinch gestures use karo. Double-tap to reset aur momentum scroll bhi add kiya hai. Gallery grid ab iPad touch ke liye itni responsive hai ki aapka hath thakega nahi, bas profit bane na bane focus bana rahega!

title: v2.9.9: News Images — Trading Without News Is Feeka
summary: Trade ke saath ab news ke screenshots bhi chipkao. MTM bars aur curves me toggle ka option bhi de diya gaya hai.
body:
NewsImages field add kiya trades.json mein. Ab aap sentiment analysis bhi kar sakte ho. 'Aaj RBI ke kalesh ne trade bigada?' — ab proof ke saath journal karo.
MTM duration aur bar-curve toggle bhi dashboard me land kiya. Statistics ab sirf numbers nahi, 'Kala' (Art) hain.

title: v2.9.8: Mobile Glow Up — Chote Screen Pe Bada Dhamaka
summary: Mobile UI ko thoda 'Clean Up' kiya. Target tracker aur gallery ke beech ki dosti gehri ho gayi hai.
body:
Mobile view pe components overlap ho rahe the, unki settings sahi ki.
Ab navigation jump nahi karta aur cards thode premium lagte hain. Trade table me icons add kiye taaki drilldown dashboard pe pahunchna easy ho.

title: v2.9.7: Weekly Target Tracker — Ab Chuna Lagna Visible Hai
summary: Har hafte ka actual vs target P/L ab bars me dikhega. SVG charts add kiye taaki metrics thode 'Ameer' (Rich) lage.
body:
📉 Weekly Hisaab Kitab

Weekly Target tab add ki. Ab pichle hafte kitna nuksaan hua, uska poora color-coded chart milega. Hover tooltips me trades, avg duration aur taxes ka poora post-mortem hai.
Flask-Compress bhi add kiya, ab API responses 840KB se 90KB ke ho gaye hain. Internet bhi bolega — 'Shukriya!'.

title: v3.0.2: Tag Images & Cross-Window Sync — Jadoo Hi Jadoo
summary: Tags ko photos mili, windows ko sync mila, aur OHLC Manager ko naya darbar. Sab kuch makkhan jaisa.
body:
🎨 Tag Images

Ab har tag ke saath ek image dikhegi. Stash restore session me 3 bade bugs ko permanently block kiya.
Multi-monitor setup walo ke liye khushkhabri — `gallery-sync.js` ab windows ke beech dosti karwayega. Ek monitor pe gallery chalao, doosre pe trades, dono saath me sync rahenge.
